periscan.config.title: PeriScan
periscan.config.ns_width.desc: Width in columns of the trenches at both Z ends of the perimeter.
periscan.config.ew_width.desc: Width in columns of the trenches at both X ends of the perimeter.
periscan.config.scan_max_y.desc: Scan up to this Y (inclusive). The scan starts just above the bedrock floor (Y = -59 in the Overworld, Y = 5 in the Nether).
periscan.config.show_pending.desc: Draw a chunk-sized box over chunks in the region that have not been scanned yet (not loaded since the region was activated). Only chunks near the camera are drawn.
periscan.config.bottom_trench.desc: In the bottom two scanned layers of the trench area (Y=-59, -58 in the overworld), every block except air and liquids is highlighted. While this zone is ON, those two layers are excluded from the "inside the trench" checks (block list and falling-block runs); while it is OFF, "inside the trench" covers them too. OFF by default, because the whole floor of a trench that is not dug yet would be highlighted.
periscan.config.zone.enabled.desc: When OFF this zone is not scanned or highlighted. A scan cannot start while all zones are OFF.
periscan.config.eater.include_trench.des: ON: the eater zone covers the whole specified region including the trenches. OFF: only the interior with the trenches removed.
periscan.config.falling_run.desc: Inside the trench, highlight spots where at least this many falling blocks (sand, gravel, concrete powder, ...) run consecutively along the trencher's direction of travel (the trench's long axis). Air, liquids and blocks destroyed by a piston push (dripstone, ...) don't count but don't interrupt the run either; only other blocks end it.
periscan.config.zone.waterlogged.desc: Also highlight waterlogged blocks in this zone. Plain water sources are never highlighted.
periscan.config.waterlogged_exclude_push: Exclude push-destroyed blocks from waterlogged check
Blocks destroyed by a piston push (leaves, coral, pointed dripstone, ...) are not highlighted as waterlogged. Shared by all zones.
periscan.config.waterlogged_blacklist.de: Blocks (id or #tag) never highlighted as waterlogged, in addition to the automatic exclusion. Shared by all zones.
periscan.config.zone.blocks.desc: Block ids (minecraft:obsidian) or block tags (#minecraft:walls). The special entry #periscan:immovable matches every block a piston cannot move: blocks with a block entity (chests, spawners, sculk sensors, ...) and blocks that refuse pushes (obsidian, reinforced deepslate, ...). Bedrock is excluded (it is terrain, not an obstruction).
periscan.config.zone.fence_blocks.desc: Blocks in this list are only highlighted in trench columns whose 1-based index from the perimeter edge has remainder 2 when divided by 3 (2, 5, 8, 11...). In other columns they do not obstruct the trencher and are ignored. Width-3 trenches survive them even in the middle column, so nothing is highlighted there. Special entries: #periscan:connecting matches blocks whose shape connects to horizontal neighbors (walls, fences, glass panes, iron bars); #periscan:redstone_reactive matches blocks whose state changes when they receive a redstone signal (doors, trapdoors, fence gates, copper bulbs, pistons, redstone dust, torches and lamps, repeaters, comparators, dispensers, hoppers, rails, TNT, ...). Blocks that only emit a signal (buttons, levers, pressure plates, observers, ...) are not included.
periscan.config.invalid_entries.title: PeriScan: invalid block entries
periscan.config.invalid_entries.message: Not a block id or tag (saved anyway, %s): %s
periscan.schematic.title: PeriScan schematics: %s
periscan.schematic.default_origin_y.desc: Origin height a newly imported schematic starts with. Existing schematics keep theirs. Around -59 suits the Overworld and 5 the Nether.
periscan.schematic.import.desc: Files to copy into this profile when you save, picked from litematica's schematics folder. Type to narrow down the suggestions, then click one. The profile keeps its own copy, so the original can be moved or deleted afterwards. Importing a file with the same name as an existing schematic replaces its copy and keeps its settings. The settings of a newly imported schematic appear below after saving. Files with the same name cannot be imported together, even from different folders.
periscan.schematic.corner.desc: Corners of the perimeter this schematic is placed on. The signs are the X and Z side of the corner. Save the schematic for the -- corner, extending toward +X/+Z; the other corners flip or rotate it so it extends into the perimeter from there. With no corner selected the schematic is not placed.
periscan.schematic.origin_y.desc: Height the schematic's origin is placed at.
periscan.schematic.remove.desc: When ON, saving removes this schematic from the profile and deletes the profile's copy of the file. Placements already made in other worlds with it can no longer be loaded.
periscan.schematic.import_failed.title: PeriScan: import failed
periscan.msg.region_too_large: PeriScan: the perimeter is %s x %s chunks. Each side can be at most %s chunks.

periscan.msg.wrong_dimension: PeriScan: profile '%s' belongs to %s. Run this command in that dimension.
periscan.msg.no_last_profile: PeriScan: nothing scanned yet. Run /peri scan start <name> first.
periscan.msg.end_not_supported: PeriScan: peris are not built in the end; this command cannot be used here.
periscan.msg.litematica_missing: PeriScan: litematica is not installed (or is an incompatible version), so schematic placement is unavailable.
periscan.msg.schem_profile_invalid_name: PeriScan: '%s' cannot be used as a schematic profile name
periscan.msg.no_schem_profile: PeriScan: no schematic profile named '%s'. Create it with /peri schematic edit <profile>.
periscan.msg.no_schem_profiles: PeriScan: no schematic profiles yet. Create one with /peri schematic edit <profile>.
periscan.msg.schem_profile_exists: PeriScan: a schematic profile named '%s' already exists
periscan.msg.schem_profile_copied: PeriScan: copied schematic profile '%s' to '%s' (%s schematic(s))
periscan.msg.schem_copy_failed: PeriScan: could not copy %s schematic file(s): %s

periscan.msg.schem_load_failed: PeriScan: failed to load %s - no placements were created

periscan.msg.schem_clear_none: PeriScan: '%s' has no placements to remove

periscan.msg.unknown_tag: PeriScan: this world has no tag %s, so it matches nothing. Check the spelling.
periscan.msg.pending_chunks: PeriScan: %s chunks not loaded yet - approach them to scan
periscan.msg.all_disabled: PeriScan: all zones are disabled. Enable at least one zone in the config.
